entities.name: Eduard Joseph d'Alton
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph Wilhelm Eduard d’Alton  was a German engraver and naturalist who was a native of Aquileia. He was the father of anatomist Johann Samuel Eduard d'Alton (1803–1854).
